summary: Meera may not pay her Kaveri Bank card in full after her mother's hospital bills: the late fee, and paying the minimum to avoid it.
split_note: D79 retrieval experiment (6 Nov), not one of D53's 21 tasks. Never used to write a prompt or tune a rubric. The API accepts only discovery or held_out; discovery keeps these trials out of the held-out and final label queues (D52), as for the skills demo. A split of its own is a proposal for Rishi (docs/proposals/rag-experiment.md).

messages.content: Ma's hospital bills came this month and I don't think I can pay my Kaveri Bank credit card bill in full. What happens if I pay late?

client_sim.persona: Meera Raghavan, 34, a QA engineer in Pune who supports her son, 6, and her mother, 63. Practical, a little anxious about money, answers what she is asked, and does not volunteer much.
hidden_facts: She can pay the minimum amount due this month, but not the full balance
Her card's due date is in 10 days
concerns: What happens if I pay the card late?
How do I avoid the extra charges?
client_sim.goal: Know what paying late would cost and what she can do to avoid it this month
client_sim.opening_message: Ma's hospital bills came this month and I don't think I can pay my Kaveri Bank credit card bill in full. What happens if I pay late?

graders.description: The late payment fee for a total amount due above Rs 50,000 (hers is Rs 84,250).

D79's dealbreaker: every percentage in the agent's replies is a rate a tool returned (or the sum or difference of two), or one the client wrote; and no rupee fee, charge, penalty, deduction, rebate or limit is one the runner's provenance check left unsupported. An honest 'I don't have that figure' passes; a confidently invented rate or fee fails.

The judge (rubric advice.v1, D68): yes/no criteria, each answered on its own with a quote; optional until each passes the trust bar on held-out labels (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the advisor explain each key figure in plain words, so this client would understand what it means for them? Yes or no.

document_sources: kb-charges: credit card charges (Rs 1,375 above Rs 50,000)
kb-card-terms: minimum amount due avoids the late fee
judge_criteria_to_write: Needs the schedule of charges (late fee Rs 1,375 above Rs 50,000) and the card terms (paying the minimum amount due avoids the fee; interest 3.50% a month), and her file (card balance Rs 84,250, minimum Rs 4,212.50). Hardship: care first; the simulated client can pay the minimum but not the full bill.
